user_profile: Personal preferences, goals, habits, values, opinions, communication style, routines, and work style preferences. Knowledge about what the user likes, dislikes, wants to achieve, and how they prefer to work.
work_context: Ongoing projects, tasks, deadlines, team members, organizations, meetings, decisions, and professional activities. Knowledge about what is being worked on, by whom, and when.

GUIDELINES:
- MULTI-LABEL: a single piece of knowledge may belong to multiple domains.
- SPECIFIC: prefer the most specific matching domain. If a child domain fits, use it instead of the parent.
- PROPOSE NEW DOMAINS: if the knowledge does not fit well into ANY existing domain, propose a new domain. Novel content deserves its own domain rather than being forced into a poor fit.

- domain_knowledge is NOT a default catch-all. Only route content there if it is genuinely about general factual/industry/scientific knowledge.
- Set confidence >= 0.3 for relevant domains, higher for strong matches.
